topic: Using Movement, Light, and Sound to Communicate
key_concepts: Gestures are body movements that carry meaning
People must agree on gesture meanings to communicate clearly
Gestures are important in daily conversations
Fire beacons and smoke signals can be used to send messages
Lighthouses use light patterns to send messages to ships
Different lighthouses use different light patterns to help ships know their location
Signal lamps communicate using light patterns
Movement, light, and sound can be combined as signals
